description: This script generates coverage reports from llvm coverage data, including merging coverage files and creating HTML and gcov reports. It references external build tools and coverage data files, and defines functions for handling coverage report generation.

methods.name: _get_raw_reports
methods.description: Retrieves raw coverage report files from the coverage directory based on test binaries.

methods.name: _get_test_binary_paths
methods.description: Determines the paths to test binaries, inferring from coverage data if not specified.

methods.name: _get_exclude_opts
methods.description: Generates a list of filename regex patterns to exclude from coverage analysis.

methods.name: _generate_reports
methods.description: Creates HTML and/or gcov coverage reports using llvm-cov.

methods.name: _merge_coverage_data
methods.description: Merges raw coverage data files into a single report file.
